ITEM 1 | Dark brown, slightly glossy, rounded/ovoid pieces about 2.5 cm across, three of them stacked near the upper left of the plate, smooth skin with uniform color, firm and holding shape | 60
ITEM 2 | Bright yellow-orange cubes and wedges with slightly uneven edges, moist surface with faint sheen, firm, cut into chunks about 1.5 to 2.5 cm, scattered across the upper center and lower left of the plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Bright red strawberries, halved and whole, glossy moist surface with small seed dots, some sliced into wedges about 2 to 3 cm, clustered on the right side of the plate | 120
ITEM 4 | Small dark blue blueberries, whole and round about 1 cm diameter, smooth skin with slight bloom, grouped on the right side near the strawberries | 15
